verses.text: Now di Philistines gather together dem armies to battle, and dem gather together for Socoh, wey belong to Judah, and camp between Socoh and Azekah, for Ephes Dammim.
Saul and di men of Israel gather together, and camp for di valley of Elah, and set di battle in array against di Philistines.
Di Philistines stand on di mountain for di one side, and Israel stand on di mountain for di other side, with di valley between dem.
One champion go out from di camp of di Philistines, Goliath im name, of Gath, im height na six cubits and one span.
E get one helmet of brass on im head, and e wear one coat of mail. Di weight of di coat na 5,000 shekels of brass.
E get brass armour on im legs, and one javelin of brass between im shoulders.
Di staff of im spear na like one weaver beam, and im spear head weigh 600 shekels of iron. One man wey carry shield go before am.

E stand and cry to di armies of Israel, talk to dem say, “Why una come out to set battle in array? I no be Philistine, and una na servants of Saul? Choose one man for una, and make am come down to me.
If e fit fight with me, and kill me, den we go be una servants. But if I prevail against am, and kill am, den una go be our servants, and serve us.”
Di Philistine talk say, “I defy di armies of Israel dis day. Give me one man, so that we go fight together.”
When Saul and all Israel hear dem words of di Philistine, dem dey dismayed, and fear plenty.
Now David na di pikin of dat Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, wey im name na Jesse. E get eight pikin man dem, and di man dey old for di days of Saul, advanced in years among men.
Di three eldest pikin man dem of Jesse go follow Saul to di battle. Di names of im three pikin man dem wey go to di battle na Eliab di firstborn, and next to am Abinadab, and di third Shammah.
David na di youngest. Di three eldest follow Saul.
David dey go from Saul and return to feed im papa sheep for Bethlehem.
Di Philistine come near morning and evening, and present imself 40 days.
Jesse talk to David im pikin man say, “Take now for your brothers one ephah of dis parched grain, and dis ten loaves, and run to di camp to your brothers.
Carry dis ten cheeses to di captain of dem thousand, and look how your brothers dey, and carry back proof from dem.”
Now Saul, and dem, and all di men of Israel, dey for di valley of Elah, dey fight with di Philistines.

David rise early for di morning, and leave di sheep with one keeper, and take di load, and go, as Jesse command am. E come to di place of di camp, as di army wey dey go out to di battle dey shout di battle cry.
Israel and di Philistines put di battle in array, army against army.
David leave im baggage in di hand of di keeper of di baggage, and run to di army, and come and greet im brothers.
As e dey talk with dem, look, di champion, di Philistine of Gath, Goliath im name, come up from di armies of di Philistines, and talk di same words, and David hear dem.
All di men of Israel, when dem see di man, run from am, and fear plenty.

Di men of Israel talk say, “Una don see dis man wey don come up? Surely e don come up to defy Israel. Di man wey kill am, di king go enrich am with great riches, and go give am im pikin woman, and go make im papa house free for Israel.”

David talk to di men wey stand by am say, “Wetin dem go do to di man wey kill dis Philistine, and take away di reproach from Israel? Who be dis uncircumcised Philistine, wey e go defy di armies of di living God?”
Di people answer am after dis manner, talk say, “So e go be done to di man wey kill am.”

Eliab im eldest brother hear when e talk to di men, and Eliab anger burn against David, and e talk say, “Why you come down? And with who you leave dem few sheep for di wilderness? I know your pride, and di naughtiness of your heart, because you come down so that you go see di battle.”
David talk say, “Wetin I don do now? Na only word?”
E turn away from am toward another, and talk di same way. Di people answer am again after di former manner.
When di words wey David talk dem hear, dem tell dem before Saul. E send for am.
David talk to Saul say, “Make nobody heart fail because of am. Your servant go go and fight with dis Philistine.”
Saul talk to David say, “You no fit go against dis Philistine to fight with am, because you na youth, and e don be man of war from im youth.”
David talk to Saul say, “Your servant dey keep im papa sheep. When one lion or one bear come, and carry one lamb out of di flock,
I go out after am, and strike am, and deliver am out of im mouth. When e rise against me, I catch am by im beard, and strike am, and kill am.
Your servant kill both lion and bear. Dis uncircumcised Philistine go be like one of dem, seeing say e don defy di armies of di living God.”

David talk say, “Di Lord wey deliver me out of di paw of di lion, and out of di paw of di bear, e go deliver me out of di hand of dis Philistine.” Saul talk to David say, “Go. Di Lord go dey with you.”
Saul clothe David with im armour. E put one helmet of brass on im head, and e clothe am with one coat of mail.
David gird im sword upon im armour, and e try to go, because e never test am. David talk to Saul say, “I no fit go with dis, because I never test dem.” David put dem off am.
E take im staff for im hand, and choose five smooth stones out of di brook, and put dem for di shepherd bag wey e get, even for im wallet. Im sling dey im hand. E draw near to di Philistine.
Di Philistine come on and draw near to David, and di man wey carry shield dey before am.
When di Philistine look around, and see David, e disdain am, because e dey but one youth, and ruddy, and handsome.
Di Philistine talk to David say, “Na dog I be, wey you come to me with sticks?” Di Philistine curse David by im gods.
Di Philistine talk to David say, “Come to me, and I go give your flesh to di birds of di sky, and to di animals of di field.”

David talk to di Philistine say, “You dey come to me with sword, and with spear, and with javelin, but I dey come to you for di name of di Lord of Armies, di God of di armies of Israel, wey you don defy.

Dis day di Lord go deliver you into my hand. I go strike you, and take your head from you. I go give di dead bodies of di army of di Philistines dis day to di birds of di sky, and to di wild animals of di earth, so that all di earth go know say Israel get God,
and so that all dis assembly go know say di Lord no dey save with sword and spear, because di battle na di Lord own, and e go give una into our hand.”
When di Philistine rise, and come and draw near to meet David, David hurry, and run toward di army to meet di Philistine.
David put im hand inside im bag, and take from dere one stone, and sling am, and strike di Philistine for im forehead. Di stone sink into im forehead, and e fall on im face to di earth.
So David prevail over di Philistine with one sling and with one stone, and strike di Philistine and kill am, but no sword dey David hand.
Den David run, and stand over di Philistine, and take im sword, and draw am out of im sheath, and kill am, and cut off im head with am. When di Philistines see say dem champion don die, dem flee.

Di men of Israel and of Judah rise, and shout, and pursue di Philistines, until dem come to di valley, and to di gates of Ekron. Di wounded of di Philistines fall down by di way to Shaaraim, even to Gath, and to Ekron.
Di pikin dem of Israel return from chasing after di Philistines, and dem plunder dem camps.
David take di head of di Philistine, and bring am to Jerusalem, but im armour e put for im tent.
When Saul see David go out against di Philistine, e talk to Abner, di captain of di army, “Abner, whose pikin man be dis youth?” Abner talk say, “As your soul live, king, I no know.”
Di king talk say, “Ask whose pikin man di young man be.”
As soon as David return from di slaughter of di Philistine, Abner take am, and bring am before Saul with di head of di Philistine for im hand.
Saul talk to am say, “Whose pikin man you be, young man?” David answer say, “I na di pikin man of your servant Jesse di Bethlehemite.”
When e don finish speaking to Saul, di soul of Jonathan join with di soul of David, and Jonathan love am as im own soul.
Saul take am dat day, and no let am go home again to im papa house.
Den Jonathan and David make covenant, because e love am as im own soul.
Jonathan strip imself of di robe wey dey on am, and give am to David, and im clothes, even to im sword, and to im bow, and to im belt.
David go out wherever Saul send am, and e behave wisely. Saul set am over di men of war, and e dey acceptable for di sight of all di people, and also for di sight of Saul servants.

E happen as dem come, when David return from di slaughter of di Philistine, say di women come out of all di cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul, with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.
Di women answer one another as dem play, and talk say, “Saul don strike im thousands, and David im ten thousands.”
Saul dey very angry, and dis saying displease am. E talk say, “Dem don give David ten thousands, and dem don give me only thousands. Wetin more fit e get but di kingdom?”
Saul eye David from dat day and onward.
E happen di next day say one evil spirit from God come mightily on Saul, and e prophesy inside di house. David play with im hand, as e dey do day by day. Saul get im spear for im hand.
Saul throw di spear, because e talk say, “I go pin David even to di wall.” David avoid am two times.
Saul dey afraid of David, because di Lord dey with am, and don leave Saul.
So Saul remove am from am, and make am im captain over 1,000, and e go out and come in before di people.
David behave wisely in all im ways, and di Lord dey with am.
When Saul see say e behave very wisely, e dey afraid of am.
But all Israel and Judah love David, because e go out and come in before dem.

Saul talk to David say, “Look, my elder pikin woman Merab, I go give you am as wife. Only be brave for me, and fight di Lord battles.” Because Saul talk say, “Make my hand no dey upon am, but make di hand of di Philistines dey upon am.”
David talk to Saul say, “Who I be? And wetin be my life, or my papa family for Israel, say I suppose become di king in-law?”
But e happen for di time wey Merab, Saul pikin woman, suppose be given to David, say dem give am to Adriel di Meholathite as wife.
Michal, Saul pikin woman, love David. Dem tell Saul, and di thing please am.
Saul talk say, “I go give am to am, so that e go be snare to am, and di hand of di Philistines go dey against am.” So Saul talk to David say, “You go become my in-law dis day for di second time.”
Saul command im servants say, “Talk to David secretly, and talk say, ‘Look, di king get delight in you, and all im servants love you. Now den, become di king in-law.’”
Saul servants speak dem words for David ears. David talk say, “Una think say na small thing to become di king in-law, seeing say I dey poor, and nobody value me?”
Saul servants tell am say, “David talk dem words.”
Saul talk say, “Talk to David say, ‘Di king no want any dowry, but 100 foreskins of di Philistines, to avenge am on di king enemies.’” Now Saul think to make David fall by di hand of di Philistines.
When im servants tell David dem words, e please David well to become di king in-law. Di days never full,

so David rise and go, e and im men, and kill 200 men of di Philistines. David bring dem foreskins, and dem give dem in full number to di king, so that e go become di king in-law. Saul give am Michal im pikin woman as wife.
Saul see and know say di Lord dey with David, and Michal, Saul pikin woman, love am.
Saul dey more afraid of David, and Saul become David enemy continually.
Den di princes of di Philistines go out to war, and e happen say as often as dem go out, David behave more wisely than all Saul servants, so tay im name get great honour.
Saul talk to Jonathan im pikin man, and to all im servants, say make dem kill David. But Jonathan, Saul pikin man, delight plenty for David.
Jonathan tell David say, “Saul my papa dey seek to kill you. Now therefore, I beg you, take heed to yourself until morning, and stay for one secret place, and hide.
I go go out and stand beside my papa for di field wia you dey, and I go speak with my papa about you. Wetin I see, I go tell you.”
Jonathan speak good of David to Saul im papa, and talk to am say, “Make di king no sin against im servant, against David, because e no sin against you, and im works don be very good to you,

because e put im life for im hand, and strike di Philistine, and di Lord work one great salvation for all Israel. You see am, and rejoice. Why den you go sin against innocent blood, to kill David without cause?”
Saul listen to di voice of Jonathan. Saul swear say, “As di Lord live, e no go be put to death.”
Jonathan call David, and Jonathan show am all dem things. Jonathan bring David to Saul, and e dey before am as before.
War dey again, and David go out, and fight with di Philistines, and kill dem with great slaughter, and dem flee before am.
One evil spirit from di Lord dey upon Saul, as e sit for im house with im spear for im hand, and David dey play with im hand.
Saul seek to pin David even to di wall with di spear, but e slip away out of Saul presence, and e strike di spear into di wall. David flee, and escape dat night.
Saul send messengers to David house, to watch am, and to kill am for di morning. Michal, David wife, tell am say, “If you no save your life tonight, tomorrow you go be killed.”
So Michal let David down through di window. E go, and flee, and escape.
Michal take di teraphim, and lay am for di bed, and put one pillow of goats hair for im head, and cover am with one cloth.
When Saul send messengers to take David, Michal talk say, “E dey sick.”
Saul send di messengers to see David, say, “Bring am up to me for di bed, so that I go kill am.”
When di messengers come in, look, di teraphim dey for di bed, with di pillow of goats hair for im head.
Saul talk to Michal say, “Why you deceive me so, and send my enemy away, so tay e escape?” Michal answer Saul say, “E talk to me say, ‘Make I go. Why I go kill you?’”
So David flee, and escape, and come to Samuel for Ramah, and tell am all wey Saul don do to am. E and Samuel go and dwell for Naioth.
Dem tell Saul say, “Look, David dey for Naioth for Ramah.”
Saul send messengers to take David. When dem see di company of di prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over dem, God Spirit come upon Saul messengers, and dem also prophesy.
When dem tell Saul, e send other messengers, and dem also prophesy. Saul send messengers again di third time, and dem also prophesy.
Den e go imself to Ramah, and come to di great well wey dey Secu. E ask say, “Wia Samuel and David dey?” One talk say, “Look, dem dey Naioth for Ramah.”
E go dere to Naioth for Ramah, and God Spirit come upon am also, and e go on, and prophesy, until e come to Naioth for Ramah.
E strip off im clothes also, and prophesy before Samuel, and lie down naked all dat day and all dat night. Dis na why dem dey talk say, “Saul dey among di prophets too?”
David flee from Naioth for Ramah, and come and talk before Jonathan say, “Wetin I don do? Wetin be my iniquity? And wetin be my sin before your papa, say e dey seek my life?”
E talk to am say, “E no fit be so! You no go die. Look, my papa no dey do anything, either great or small, but e go show am to me. Why my papa go hide dis thing from me? E no be so.”

David swear again, and talk say, “Your papa know well say I don find favour for your eyes, and e talk say, ‘Make Jonathan no know dis, make e no grieve.’ But truly as di Lord live, and as your soul live, na only one step dey between me and death.”
Den Jonathan talk to David say, “Whatever your soul desire, I go even do am for you.”
David talk to Jonathan say, “Look, tomorrow na di new moon, and I suppose sit with di king to eat. But make I go, so that I go hide for di field until di third evening.
If your papa miss me at all, den talk say, ‘David earnestly ask leave of me to run to Bethlehem im city, because na yearly sacrifice dey dere for all di family.’
If e talk say, ‘E dey well,’ your servant get peace. But if e dey very angry, den know say evil dey determined by am.
Therefore deal kindly with your servant, because you don bring your servant into di covenant of di Lord with you. But if iniquity dey me, kill me yourself, because why you go bring me to your papa?”
Jonathan talk say, “E no fit be so! If I know say evil dey determined by my papa to come on you, I no go tell you am?”
Den David talk to Jonathan say, “Who go tell me if your papa answer you roughly?”
Jonathan talk to David say, “Come, make we go out into di field.” Di two of dem go out into di field.

Jonathan talk to David say, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, be witness! When I don sound out my papa about dis time tomorrow, or di third day, look, if good dey toward David, and I no send to you, and show am to you,

di Lord do so and more also to Jonathan. But if e please my papa to do you evil, den I go show am to you, and send you away, so that you go go in peace. Make di Lord dey with you, as e don dey with my papa.
You no go only show me di kindness of di Lord while I still dey live, so that I no die,
but also you no go cut off your kindness from my house forever. No, even when di Lord don cut off every one of di enemies of David from di face of di earth.”
So Jonathan make covenant with di house of David, talk say, “Make di Lord require am at di hand of David enemies.”
Jonathan cause David to swear again, because of di love wey e get for am, because e love am as e love im own soul.
Jonathan talk to am say, “Tomorrow na di new moon, and dem go miss you, because your seat go dey empty.
When you don stay three days, you go go down quickly, and come to di place wia you hide yourself when di business dey hand, and go stay by di stone Ezel.
I go shoot three arrows for di side of am, as though I shoot at one mark.
Look, I go send di boy say, ‘Go, find di arrows.’ If I talk to di boy say, ‘Look, di arrows dey for dis side of you, take dem,’ den come, because e dey peace to you and no hurt, as di Lord live.
But if I talk dis way to di young man, ‘Look, di arrows dey beyond you,’ go your way, because di Lord don send you away.
As touching di matter wey you and I don talk of, look, di Lord dey between you and me forever.”
So David hide imself for di field. When di new moon come, di king sit down to eat food.
Di king sit upon im seat, as at other times, even upon di seat by di wall. Jonathan stand up, and Abner sit by Saul side, but David place dey empty.
Still Saul talk nothing dat day, because e think say, “Something don happen to am. E dey unclean. Surely e dey unclean.”
E happen on di next day, di second day of di month, say David place dey empty. Saul talk to Jonathan im pikin man say, “Why Jesse pikin man no come to di meal, either yesterday or today?”
Jonathan answer Saul say, “David earnestly ask leave of me to go to Bethlehem.

E talk say, ‘Make I go, I beg you, because our family get sacrifice for di city, and my brother don command me to dey dere. Now if I don find favour for your eyes, make I go away, I beg you, and see my brothers.’ Dis na why e no come to di king table.”

Den Saul anger burn against Jonathan, and e talk to am say, “You pikin man of di perverse rebellious woman, I no know say you don choose di pikin man of Jesse to your own shame, and to di shame of your mama nakedness?
Because as long as di pikin man of Jesse live upon di earth, you no go dey established, nor your kingdom. Now send and bring am to me, because e must surely die.”
Jonathan answer Saul im papa, and talk to am say, “Why e suppose die? Wetin e don do?”
Saul throw im spear for am to strike am, so Jonathan know say im papa don determine to kill David.
So Jonathan rise from di table in fierce anger, and eat no food di second day of di month, because e dey grieve for David, because im papa don shame am.
E happen for di morning say Jonathan go out into di field at di time appointed with David, and one small boy dey with am.
E talk to im boy say, “Run, find now di arrows wey I shoot.” As di boy run, e shoot one arrow beyond am.
When di boy reach di place of di arrow wey Jonathan shoot, Jonathan cry after di boy, and talk say, “Di arrow no dey beyond you?”
Jonathan cry after di boy say, “Make speed, hurry, no stay!” Jonathan boy gather up di arrows, and come to im oga.
But di boy no know anything. Only Jonathan and David know di matter.
Jonathan give im weapons to im boy, and talk to am say, “Go, carry dem to di city.”
As soon as di boy don go, David rise from out of di south, and fall on im face to di ground, and bow three times. Dem kiss one another, and weep one with another, until David weep pass.

Jonathan talk to David say, “Go in peace, because we two don swear for di name of di Lord, talk say, ‘Di Lord dey between me and you, and between my seed and your seed forever.’” David rise and depart, and Jonathan go into di city.
Den David come to Nob to Ahimelech di priest. Ahimelech come to meet David dey tremble, and talk to am say, “Why you dey alone, and no man dey with you?”

David talk to Ahimelech di priest say, “Di king don command me one matter, and don talk to me say, ‘Make nobody know anything of di matter wey I send you, and wey I command you.’ I don appoint di young men to one certain place.
Now wetin dey your hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever dey available.”
Di priest answer David say, “No common bread dey under my hand, but holy bread dey, if only di young men don keep away from women.”

David answer di priest say, “Truly women no dey near us, as e dey always when I go out. Di vessels of di young men dey holy, even though na common journey. E go dey more so today, say dem vessels dey holy.”
So di priest give am holy bread, because no bread dey dere but di showbread, wey dem take from before di Lord, to put hot bread for di day wey dem take am away.
Now one of Saul servants dey dere dat day, detained before di Lord. Im name na Doeg di Edomite, di chief of Saul herdsmen.
David talk to Ahimelech say, “You no get spear or sword under your hand here? Because I no carry my sword or my weapons with me, because di king business dey urgent.”

Di priest talk say, “Di sword of Goliath di Philistine, wey you kill for di valley of Elah, look, e dey wrapped for cloth behind di ephod. If you go take am for yourself, take am, because no other dey here except dis one.” David talk say, “Dere no dey like am. Give am to me.”
David rise, and flee dat day for fear of Saul, and go to Achish di king of Gath.
Achish servants talk to am say, “Dis no be David di king of di land? Dem no sing about am to each other for dance, talk say, ‘Saul don strike im thousands, and David im ten thousands’?”
David lay up dem words for im heart, and fear Achish di king of Gath plenty.
E change im behaviour before dem, and pretend to dey mad for dem hands, and scribble on di doors of di gate, and let im spittle fall down upon im beard.
Den Achish talk to im servants say, “Look, una see say di man dey mad. Why una bring am to me?
Na me lack madmen, say una don bring dis man to play di madman for my presence? Dis one go come into my house?”
David depart from dere, and escape to di cave of Adullam. When im brothers and all im papa house hear am, dem go down dere to am.
Everyone wey dey distress, and everyone wey dey debt, and everyone wey dey discontented, gather together to am, and e become captain over dem. About 400 men dey with am.
David go from dere to Mizpah of Moab. E talk to di king of Moab say, “Make my papa and my mama, I beg you, come out and dey with una, until I know wetin God go do for me.”
E bring dem before di king of Moab, and dem dwell with am all di time wey David dey di stronghold.
Di prophet Gad talk to David say, “No stay for di stronghold. Depart, and go into di land of Judah.” Den David depart, and come into di forest of Hereth.
Saul hear say dem don discover David, and di men wey dey with am. Now Saul dey stay for Gibeah, under di tamarisk tree for Ramah, with im spear for im hand, and all im servants dey stand about am.
Saul talk to im servants wey stand about am say, “Hear now, una Benjamites! Di pikin of Jesse go give una all fields and vineyards? E go make una all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds,

say una don all conspire against me, and nobody dey wey tell me when my pikin man make league with di pikin of Jesse, and none of una dey sorry for me, or tell me say my pikin man don stir up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at dis day?”
Den Doeg di Edomite, wey stand by Saul servants, answer say, “I see di pikin of Jesse come to Nob, to Ahimelech di pikin of Ahitub.
E enquire of di Lord for am, and give am provisions, and give am di sword of Goliath di Philistine.”
Den di king send to call Ahimelech di priest, di pikin of Ahitub, and all im papa house, di priests wey dey Nob. Dem all come to di king.
Saul talk say, “Hear now, you pikin of Ahitub.” E answer say, “Look, I dey here, my oga.”

Saul talk to am say, “Why una don conspire against me, you and di pikin of Jesse, in dat you don give am bread, and one sword, and don enquire of God for am, so that e go rise against me, to lie in wait, as at dis day?”
Den Ahimelech answer di king say, “Who among all your servants dey so faithful as David, wey be di king in-law, and go at your bidding, and dey honourable for your house?

Na today I begin to enquire of God for am? E no fit be so! Make di king no impute anything to im servant, nor to all di house of my papa, because your servant know nothing of all dis, small or great.”
Di king talk say, “You must surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your papa house.”

Di king talk to di guard wey stand about am say, “Turn, and kill di priests of di Lord, because dem hand too dey with David, and because dem know say e flee, and no tell me.” But di servants of di king no put out dem hand to strike di priests of di Lord.
Di king talk to Doeg say, “Turn, and strike di priests.” Doeg di Edomite turn, and e strike di priests, and kill dat day 85 persons wey wear linen ephod.
E strike Nob, di city of di priests, with di edge of di sword, men and women, small pikin and baby wey dey suck, and ox and donkey and sheep, with di edge of di sword.
One of di pikin man dem of Ahimelech di pikin of Ahitub, wey im name na Abiathar, escape, and flee after David.
Abiathar tell David say Saul don kill di Lord priests.
David talk to Abiathar say, “I know dat day, when Doeg di Edomite dey dere, say e go surely tell Saul. I don cause di death of all di persons of your papa house.
Stay with me, no fear, because di one wey seek my life dey seek your life, but with me you go dey safe.”
